fact: The national meteorological service's own page describes access to EUMETSAT NWCSAF satellite-based nowcasting products (0-6 hours) with real-time satellite data visualisation via the ADAguc platform.

TechReviewAfrica reports Cameroon's National Meteorological Directorate began installing a PUMA-2025 satellite data reception station on 22 July 2025, to receive Meteosat Third Generation data every 10 minutes.
